model_and_runtime_storage_dcc.method: du -sb on a DCC CPU compute node

retrieval_store_summary.interpretation: Historical M4 stores cover the original three-document RMS corpus. They are not a unified cross-corpus production database.

snapshot_limitations: SQLite files were opened immutable/read-only. A concurrent-writer snapshot was not needed because these historical stores have no WAL/SHM companions and are closed artifacts.
JSON and JSONL stores are numerous historical artifacts rather than one normalized database.
DCC cache sizes are physical du values and include cached models other than the final 32B model; hard-linked or shared blob accounting follows du semantics.
